info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Fitness Memberships Billings-v5-spec
info.description: The Fitness Memberships Billing API provides access to detailed billing information related to fitness memberships. It allows users to retrieve historical billing records, view billing statuses, and track payment activities. This API is ideal for gym owners, fitness center administrators, and accounting departments who need insights into membership billing cycles. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance financial reporting and improve customer engagement with accurate billing data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the billing information associated with memberships. You can use this to understand billing cycles, charges, and payment status related to your memberships.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves the billing information associated with memberships. It expects a JSON payload and will return details regarding the current billing status and related information.

ListFitnessMembershipsBillingsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to memberships billing. It is represented as a simple string.
